title: Chupe De Camarones
notes: Aji Panca is a deep-red pepper widely used in Peruvian cooking, it has little spice and smoky, sweet and fruity flavours. Amarillo Chiles are yellow in colour and have a bit more spice while still being fruity. South American specialty stores will stock these pastes if your supermarket doesn't.

ingredientSections.heading: Chupe De Camarones
items: 2 Tomatoes, peeled seeded and finely chopped

methodSections.heading: Shellfish Stock
steps: You can use the heads and shells from the shrimp to make the stock but at Chicha these are left on for presentation purposes. Therefore, your version of this dish will have headless shrimp unless you have heads and shells available from another recipe. You could also use the fish trimmings from another fish recipe. This is a great way to make the most out of your seafood and the resulting stock is better than anything you could buy.
Remove the heads and shells from the shrimp and set aside the meat in the fridge.
Sauté the heads and shells in olive oil. Deglaze with the tomato paste and white wine.
Add the fish trimmings, onion, celery, fennel, garlic, peppercorns, thyme, bay leaves and water.
Bring to the boil, reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.

methodSections.heading: Chupe De Camarones
steps: Wash the mussels. Cut the white fish into cubes.
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and sauté until translucent.
Add the chilli paste, aji panca and tomato paste. Deglaze the pot with the Pisco, reduce then add the tomatoes, ground cumin, oregano and shrimp stock.
Bring to the boil, add the fingerling potatoes and then simmer for about 20 minutes. Add salt and pepper to taste and a touch of sugar to balance the soup.
Add the fresh white fish, mussels, and shrimp and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the frozen peas and cook for one more minute.
In a separate pan, poach or fry the eggs.
In a pot of water boil the corn and potatoes until cooked.
Serve the soup into 4 bowls evenly dividing the seafood. Add the fresh cheese, egg and potatoes. Cut the corn cob into 4 pieces and place one piece into each bowl. Top with cilantro.
